phases.name: input freeze and first inventory
phases.basis: Recorded manifest and inventory freeze timestamps.

phases.name: fresh Lean signature and trust check
phases.basis: Execution interval recorded in the audit work notes; includes an initial incorrect declaration-name query followed by correction and successful check. Exact shell start/stop timestamps were not captured.

phases.name: independent source review
phases.basis: Reviewer-reported approximate duration; performed in parallel with report preparation. No compilation.

phases.name: reconciliation and report closeout
phases.basis: Observed closeout interval through final manifest generation and strict OpenSpec/diff validation.

notes: The check ceiling did not require waiting for 60 minutes; the bounded question was resolved sooner.
Preparation, checking and review are separated. Reviewer duration is approximate and overlapped author work.
The review was supplied only frozen inputs; the reviewer reports no checkout inspection and no compile.
No historical or prior run effort is represented as zero-cost; no paired comparator was run.
